grade_rationale.text: Machal records the Dolya as Russian tradition.
Machal records the Sreća as the Serbian counterpart of the Russian Dolya.
Afanasyev independently prints Dolya and Nedolya tales, songs and sayings, including a Little-Russian tale and its Great-Russian version.

Machal's passage on the Dolya cites no source, so it is counted independent of Afanasyev, although the services of the good Dolya he lists closely follow those the Dolya names in Afanasyev's Little-Russian tale.
The Serbian evidence rests on Machal alone; Karadžić glosses Срећа only as the common word fortuna.
